title: Drummers and pianists in the alley group, including Wilhelmina Bart
summary: Barnes lists drummers and pianists he played with, including Johnny Bean and the pianist Wilhelmina Bart, whom he calls a classical player who was good in bands.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: You mentioned the drummer, wasn't it? John Bean, was he the drummer?
Johnny Bean, John Bean. Then we had Walter Blenden.
You see, we had Walter Blenden and who else? We had a couple of them, white Gasper. You see, well, his wife says, no, no. Then we got, who else?
Wait a minute. Hold up. Hold up. Hey, hey, hey, hey. I guess it's all right.
Guitars. Piano. John William and Bart was on piano. Then we had...
Who was on piano? William and Bart?

Oh, yeah. We was trying to interview her. I think she lives across the lake someplace. Dick Allen was gonna see her. How did she play? Was she a good jazzy pianist or mostly classics or what'd she do?
She was a classic piano player. Some of all, she was jazz and everything else.
Did she play all right in the band though?
Oh she was good for bands. Addison Piper, huh? Yeah. Addison Piper. We had another one to play, how do they call him again? George something. Clarinet? No, no piano. Oh piano.
Yeah. Henia, Frank Henia, was he around?
